summary: Temporary danger area EGD499C near Whitby for search and rescue operations, up to 2,500 feet above sea level, 3 nautical miles radius.
text:
TEMPORARY DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD499C INSTALLED WI A 3NM RADIUS 
CIRCLE CENTRED ON 5428N 00033W PSN WHITBY. SAR OPS ON, NO 
RESTRICTIONS ON FREQUENCY. TO ENSURE SAFETY AND AVOID INTERFERENCE 
WITH CTL AND SAR ACTIVITIES, PILOTS ARE REQ NOT TO FLY IN OR NEAR 
THE AREA WO PERMISSION OF THE EMERG CONTROLLING AUTHORITY VIA TELE 
03443 820800. ACTION MAY BE TAKEN TO IMPOSE RESTRICTIONS OF FLYING 
REGULATIONS UNDER ARTICLE 239 OF THE AIR NAVIGATION ORDER 2016. 
ATC UNITS CLOSE TO THE INCIDENT AREA ARE REQ TO ADVISE ACFT ON 
THEIR FREQ OF THE CONTENTS OF THIS NOTAM.
